title: Operator: install the GitHub App on 14 census repositories so adopt --verify exits 0
body:
Why: the same census rerun shows `krn adopt <clone> --verify` exits 67 (APP_NOT_INSTALLED_EXIT in src/adopt/verify.ts) for 14 of 15 repositories: "GitHub App not installed on <owner>/<repo>" (only krn-zakupy exits 0). This is an operator action (installing the GitHub App is an install grant), not a code defect. Standards check exits 1 on all 15 with real gaps (mostly s-test-command, s-ci-runs-tests, s-linter-configured), which adopt reports without fixing.
Outcome: the operator installs the KRN GitHub App on the listed repositories, or decides which are out of scope; then verify exits 0 for them.
Proof: rerun of the census shows verify 0 for the repositories where the App was installed.
